constructors: Callers assemble ToolInvocationContext literals; ToolFacade is the canonical entry that forwards into the ExecutionSecurityKernel.
productionCallers: ToolFacade.ExecuteModelTool (tool_facade.go) — resolution entry; forwards through to ExecutionPipeline
All chat/agent callers go through ToolFacade or Task/Workflow services which route to the same kernel
executionConsumers: InvocationValidator.Validate — enforces InvocationID, UserID, Source, ToolID
ScopeGate / PermissionGate / ApprovalGate / AvailabilityGate / DepthGuard / ConcurrencyController / TimeoutController / CancellationController — all consume the same ToolInvocationContext
runtimeConsumers: RuntimeAdapter.Execute(ctx, binding, invocation, input) — every adapter signature accepts ToolInvocationContext
inputContextSeparation: Tool.Input (ToolInvocation in old legacy struct) is a separate DTO carrying user data; ToolInvocationContext carries system identity. Both coexist on ToolExecutionRequest but serve distinct roles.
